# Keep inherited task image references aligned with upstream dependencies

383 adds fetch-more to the inherited docker-image reference tasks. Current kind uses the comm merge loader and reference-base-path taskcluster/kinds, with fetch-more still listed. The initial bustage commit has no review trailer; Bug 1903846 attachedD214426 was read and accepted without inline requests, then closed later. This supports the task dependency wiring, not a manual style rule inferred from silent acceptance. No taskgraph or container build run.

Scope: Build.
